presets.name: Website
presets.instructions: Extract the ZIP and upload every file together to an HTTP(S) website, keeping the relative paths. Link to index.html.

presets.name: Other LMS
presets.instructions: Import the unopened ZIP as a SCORM 1.2 package in a test course.

presets.name: Other LMS
presets.instructions: Confirm that the LMS supports SCORM 2004 4th Edition, then import the unopened ZIP in a test course.

presets.name: Other LMS
presets.instructions: Import the unopened ZIP as a Tin Can package. The LMS launch must supply learner identity, registration and temporary LRS authorization.

presets.name: Other LMS
presets.instructions: Import the unopened ZIP as a cmi5 course. It needs a cmi5 launch and is not a Tin Can package.

presets.name: Litmos
presets.instructions: Add the unopened ZIP to a test course as a SCORM 1.2 module. Record the import settings and launch mode used.

presets.name: Moodle
presets.instructions: In a test course, add a SCORM package activity and upload the unopened ZIP. Moodle does not provide native SCORM 2004 support.
